title: Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery
description:
Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Are you looking for a dynamic, growth-oriented career working with extraordinary people with a mission to provide world-class products and customer service? Rotoflow , An Air Products Business, may be the place for you!
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM providing a comprehensive range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our global customers. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include our wide-ranging proprietary turbo-expanders and related equipment consisting of new equipment designs, upgrades and repairs along with a full complement of supporting services. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
We are currently seeking a Mechanical Designer to join our team at our global headquarters in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. This role involves minimal travel.
Do you have a passion for precision design, solving unique engineering challenges, and contributing to world-class machinery development? Rotoflow is looking for a Mechanical Designer who thrives in a collaborative environment and is excited to work on high-speed rotating machinery and support systems. If this sounds like you, come grow with us as we continue to build a sustainable tomorrow together.
Rotoflow Employees Enjoy

  • Being part of a world class engineering, manufacturing, and business organization developing machinery solutions for our customers,
  • Collaborating with a multi-functional team across sales, engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope,
  • Tapping into the wealth of technical experience available within Rotoflow and the opportunity to explore technical interests,
  • Being part of a team of highly motivated individuals,
  • Seeing projects come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing,
  • The ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Responsible for equipment design and development, layout, detailed part drawing creation, BOM generation, manufacturing, purchasing and production support as necessary throughout projects,
  • Creation of 3D CAD models of turbomachinery components including complex geometries such as radial impellers,
  • Creation of 2D and 3D CAD layouts,
  • Creation of 2D drawings using geometric dimensioning,
  • Perform stack-up analysis of precision machinery,
  • Interface with a broad spectrum of suppliers and disposition part variations and deviations,
  • Create conceptual layouts to support new product development,
  • Perform quality and technical checks of drawings and documents as a checker,
  • Designing and creating manufacturing drawings for tooling associated with servicing turbomachinery,
  • Creation, revision, and maintenance of part numbers, part routings and bills of materials in Air Products’ ERP system (SAP),
  • The successful candidate will need to interact with colleagues including proposals, project management, engineering, shop operations, and field service engineers,
  • Promote safety and diversity consistent with the philosophies of Rotoflow.
Required Skills / Abilities
  • 2D and 3D CAD, simulation, and FEA experience a plus,
  • Working knowledge of ERP and MRP Systems a plus,
  • Knowledge of turbomachinery or other high speed rotating machinery a strong plus,
  • Time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and as a team,
  • Strong knowledge Microsoft Office tools,
  • Attention to detail and written and oral communication skills,
  • Understanding of revision control philosophy,
  • Experience with tolerancing and stack-up philosophies,
  • Experience with design of assembly tooling,
  • Experience with SolidWorks and Bentley MicroStation or AutoCAD a strong plus,
  • Experience with SAP ERP system a strong plus.
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • Associates Degree in Mechanical Design or equivalent. BS in a technical field a plus,
  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a mechanical design occupation. 10+ years' experience a plus,
  • Basic knowledge of ANSI GD&T.
Working Conditions And/or Benefits Of This Role
  • This is a full-time position based in Bethlehem, PA,
  • You will be expected to work on-site 5 days per week during initial training. There is potential to transition to a hybrid work schedule,
  • Minimal travel required,
  • Opportunity for career growth and increasing responsibility,
  • Be part of a motivated, technically skilled team,
  • See your designs come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing.
If you are dedicated and driven to achieve your objectives and company goals, have passion and commitment to get it right, have a never-ending desire to learn, improve, and contribute, then come discover, care, accomplish and thrive at Air Products!
To learn more, visit Air Products and Rotoflow.
Air Products proudly values the skills, dedication, and leadership that veterans bring to the table. As a veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome veterans to apply for various roles within our company. We recognize the unique strengths and experiences that veterans contribute, and we foster a workplace that honors your service while providing a platform for professional growth.
We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end-to-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visitAbout Air Products.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including paid holidays and vacation, affordable medical, dental, life insurance and retirement plans. You will be eligible for benefits and also be 100% vested in your retirement benefits on your first day of employment.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (U.S.). You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, citizenship, gender, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or veteran status.
Air Products is committed to working with and providing a reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. You will also be involved in reviewing account documentation, drafting customer-facing communications, and working on special projects. This role requires excellent legal research skills, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
The team is responsible for advising the firm’s client-facing wealth management business. Such legal support will primarily concern laws within the United States. The successful candidate will support the Firm’s Advisors, Sales Management, Operations, and Supervisory teams while working closely with colleagues on the The J.P. Morgan Wealth Management Legal team, Compliance, Controls and Risk to ensure comprehensive and effective support.

  • Thrive in a high-paced, deadline-promote organization, where timely execution of high-quality work product is expected.

  • Draft or edit certain customer facing communications.
  • Conduct legal and market research.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in legal practice.
  • Excellent legal research skills. A team player who can collaborate and communicate effectively with attorneys and other business and compliance professionals.
  • Strong analytical thinker who is detail-oriented, practical and skilled at issue spotting and problem solving.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Knowledge of U.S. financial service law and process.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.

Monitor key metrics (e.g., new users volume, retention rate, and frequency) and adjust strategies accordingly.

  • Highly energetic, self-motivated and proactive.Organized and structured, ability to identify business needs.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion
Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.
We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. Por aqui, o dia a dia é dinâmico, repleto de desafios e objeções a serem contornadas contribuindo com as equipes de tecnologia de forma constante. Por isso, procuramos profissionais resilientes, com habilidade para lidar com clientes de alto nível e exigentes quanto a agilidade do serviço em um ambiente em constante mudança.

Se identifica com esse cenário e tem paixão em agregar valor ao produto através de um suporte especializado com foco na excelência do serviço para nossos clientes e parceiros? Confira essa vaga!

Os principais desafios da posição são:

  • Atendimento ao cliente nos mais diversos canais, através do Zendesk (chat e e-mail);
  • Apoio ao cliente para o melhor uso dos nossos produtos (Profit, Vector, BlackArrow e diversas soluções desenvolvidas para o mercado financeiro);
  • Resolução de dúvidas e análise de casos críticos;
  • Abertura e acompanhamento de chamados, através do Jira;

O que é essencial que você apresente:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no turno diurno (08h às 17h) em escala 5x2 - com folgas rotativas;

  • Identificação com atendimento ao público e paixão por solucionar problemas.

O que é um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em relação ao mercado financeiro;
  • Experiência profissional consistente na área de suporte técnico e vivência com atendimento multicanal;
  • Conhecimento na plataforma Zendesk ou outras semelhantes;
  • Conhecimento em Inglês.

Informações adicionais

Consideramos como diferenciais experiências complementares além da atuação profissional, como o envolvimento acadêmico (PETs, mentorias, cursos, competições etc), ou envolvimento em comunidades de sua área de atuação, trabalho voluntário entre outros.

Além disso, por aqui jogamos juntos para promover um ambiente cada dia mais inclusivo, que valoriza todas as trajetórias independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia ou deficiência.

title: Data Product Manager | BEES Personalization
description:
AB InBev is the global beer leader and one of the top 5 consumer goods companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, we are number one or two in many of the world's key beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About the ABI Growth Group

Founded in 2022, the Growth Group unites our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global technology and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables us to make the most of data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev worldwide.

In addition to supporting globally recognized beer brands such as Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust set of digital products, including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and the PerfectDraft beer keg system.

We are an exceptional team focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, leveraging new technologies, and increasing growth opportunities.

Data Product Manager

The Data Product Manager of the Bees Personalization team is responsible for designing and developing all data products within their squad.

This position's mission is to organize, prioritize, and execute the activities in the backlog, aligned with stakeholder needs, while always maintaining a critical and proactive perspective. The role involves measuring the value generated by each activity and the development effort, conducting product impact analyses, and using them to solve problems.

The Data Product Manager is responsible for leading all squad ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, planning, retrospectives, reviews, and refinements (both technical and product-related), as well as organizing the sprint agendas.

The role also requires documentation of all features and product descriptions, explaining models in an intermediate language between academic and corporate documentation, so they are easily interpretable by the technical team (scientists and engineers) and business stakeholders. Knowledge of agile methodologies and CRISP-DM, along with management tools like Confluence and DevOps, is crucial for this role.

This position requires deep business knowledge, as well as a technical background that allows programming skills in key languages like SQL, PySpark, and Python. Additionally, knowledge of data science fundamentals is required, including the ability to code main models and algorithms, interpret and critique results, and propose the best modeling approaches in collaboration with data scientists.

Data engineering knowledge is essential to contribute to discussions with data engineers and a basic understanding of BI modeling. The squad has a global scope, covering all major BEES business units and partner industries. Each squad will consist of 11 to 17 members, with the product manager as the team leader. Strong soft skills such as clear communication, didactics, leadership (both vertical and horizontal), flexibility, teamwork, and experience working with multiple stakeholders are key for success.

What You’ll Do:

  • Take responsibility for leading teams as a Product Manager, ensuring successful delivery of features and services. Demonstrate ownership and responsibility for the product’s success.
  • Build strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, becoming the authority on feature launches, product roadmaps, and user pain points. Act as the voice of the customer, advocating for their needs and ensuring their satisfaction.
  • Collaborate effectively with teams such as engineering, design, product, data science, and commercial. Work closely with the Data team to leverage their expertise in driving data-informed decisions and insights.
  • Define success metrics for features or services and monitor performance.
  • Understand complex problems across business units, geographies, and product lines. Formulate hypotheses and translate them into requirements, identifying significant insights to guide product development.
  • Create roadmaps based on relevant requirements and dependencies. Ensure alignment with business and strategic goals.

What You Need:

  • Write detailed business requirements and user stories that serve as the basis for creating product specifications. Ensure clear communication and alignment with the development team.
  • Experience in managing an agile development process. Collaborate with development teams to ensure efficient and effective product delivery.
  • Use data and metrics to support assumptions, develop business cases, and drive improvements.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills to extract insights from data.
  • A desire to learn the processes, systems, and business functions needed to operate a world-class B2B sales operation. Continuously seek opportunities for growth and improvement.
  • Desired knowledge in SQL and Data Analysis.

More About You:

  • You are driven by building world-class solutions that impact millions of users globally.
  • Experience working in an environment that uses and encourages a DevOps culture.
  • You are creative in solving problems and continually seek improvements for processes and solutions.
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify problems and demands.
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, assessing the impact of your results on the final outcome.

Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action:

AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected characteristics.

São Paulo

Seu bem-estar importa. Junte-se a uma empresa que se importa também

Wellhub (antes, Gympass*) é uma plataforma de bem-estar corporativo que conecta os colaboradores aos melhores parceiros para exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono, tudo incluso em uma assinatura que custa menos do que a individual de cada parceiro. Fundada em 2012 e sediada em Nova York, nossa empresa tem uma equipe crescente em 11 países. No Wellhub, você tem a oportunidade de construir a sua carreira em uma empresa de tecnologia de alto crescimento, que coloca o bem-estar como base da sua cultura e, além disso, contribui para fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.*Grande novidade: Gympass agora é Wellhub! Estamos felizes em anunciar nossa mudança de marca para Wellhub, um marco significativo na nossa jornada. Essa transformação reflete nossa evolução de “passe para academias” para uma solução ampla de bem-estar para colaboradores. Com nossa identidade atualizada, estamos prontos para embarcar em um capítulo novo e empolgante de crescimento e expansão. Estamos elevando nossa oferta, incluindo uma experiência completamente nova em nosso app e expansão da rede de nossos parceiros de bem-estar. Veja mais sobre isso aqui.

Porque temos um programa de Vagas Afirmativas para Pessoas com

No Wellhub, acreditamos no poder da diversidade e na importância de um ambiente de trabalho verdadeiramente inclusivo. Para nós, bem-estar é para todos, e isso se reflete em nosso compromisso em garantir que cada pessoa tenha acesso a oportunidades equitativas e possa alcançar seu máximo potencial. Para alcançar a nossa missão, é essencial garantir que todas as pessoas se sintam acolhidas, valorizadas e empoderadas no Wellhub.

Nosso time está sempre atento aos talentos que chegam por aqui! Analisamos os currículos semanalmente e os direcionamos para as áreas onde temos oportunidades abertas. Se no momento não houver uma vaga específica para o seu perfil, não se preocupe! Manteremos seu currículo em nosso banco de talentos e entraremos em contato assim que surgir uma posição que combine com suas habilidades e aspirações.

Para garantir um processo de recrutamento justo e equitativo, priorizamos a revisão dos currículos enviados por este canal para as vagas que abrimos na área de interesse que você indicar.

  • Pessoas com deficiência que se identifiquem com a Cultura do Wellhub e queiram fazer parte do nosso time;
  • Ter paixão por bem-estar e querer ser parte ativa de uma missão que transforma vidas;
  • Acredita no poder da colaboração e prospera em um time onde a autonomia e a responsabilidade são valorizadas.
  • Tem um olhar curioso para os desafios, buscando sempre soluções inovadoras e melhorias contínuas como uma pessoa agente de mudança.
  • Enxerga cada desafio como uma oportunidade de aprendizado, com confiança para evoluir e inspirar.

Somos uma empresa comprometida com a saúde e bem estar das nossas pessoas colaboradoras.

Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios Flex, que inclui:

WELLNESS: Seguro Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida.

TRABALHO FLEXÍVEL: No Wellhub, a flexibilidade gera um ambiente de trabalho mais feliz, saudável e produtivo para todas as pessoas. Como uma empresa de trabalho flexível, oferecemos dois modelos: híbrido-flexível e remoto, e fazemos do escritório um lugar para colaboração e construção de equipe. Você também vai receber um reembolso no primeiro mês de trabalho para equipar seu escritório remoto.

CRONOGRAMA FLEXÍVEL: Entendemos que, juntos, todos os Wellhubbers e suas pessoas líderes podem tomar as melhores decisões para seus escopos particulares. Isso inclui a flexibilidade para ajustar as horas de trabalho com base nos cronogramas pessoais, fuso horário e necessidades de negócio.

WELLHUB: Você vai receber o plano Gold+ do Wellhub de graça e outros planos premium com descontos significativos. Vai poder acessar diversas academias e estúdios fitness, além de soluções digitais de bem estar, incluindo meditação, nutrição, saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais.

FÉRIAS/DAY-OFF: Nós sabemos a importância de tirar um tempo para desconectar do trabalho e recarregar as energias. Por isso, nós oferecemos: Férias após 6 meses + 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga durante o mês do seu aniversário + 1 dia de folga a cada aniversário de casa (somando até 5 dias).

LICENÇA PARENTAL PAGA: Receber um novo filho é um dos momentos mais especiais da vida e nós queremos que as nossas pessoas colaboradoras possam tirar uma licença para aproveitar a família. Fazemos parte do programa Empresa Cidadã e também oferecemos licença para pais adotivos.

CRESCIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Excelentes oportunidades de crescimento pessoal e profissional com foco no seu desenvolvimento.

CULTURA: Entre em uma atmosfera motivadora e de apoio constante, com pessoas de diversos cantos do mundo. Você vai construir parcerias com colegas de diversos países e fazer parte do sucesso de uma empresa de tecnologia que não para de crescer, que traz soluções revolucionárias no seu segmento. Aqui, a sua autonomia vai se transformar em um impacto duradouro no negócio e no mundo. Nossa cultura baseada em confiança, flexibilidade e integridade torna isso possível todos os dias. Entenda mais sobre ela em nossa página de carreiras !

Para saber um pouco mais sobre a Vida no Wellhub: Siga nossas páginas no Instagram @lifeatwellhub e LinkedIn !

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão no Wellhub

O Wellhub é um empregador comprometido com a promoção de oportunidades iguais.

Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, sexo, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência física ou mental não desqualificadora, nacionalidade, condição de veterano ou qualquer outra base coberta pela lei apropriada.

  • Trabalhar juntamente com o time de design na criação de CTAs e outras formas alinhadas às estratégias de conversão
  • Pesquisar ativamente novas estratégias: analisar benchmarks do mercado e concorrência, buscando aumentar o engajamento e inovação
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado e comportamento do público, analisando concorrentes para adaptar estratégias
  • Planejar, criar e gerenciar campanhas publicitárias pagas nas redes sociais
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Procuramos uma pessoa com as seguintes competências:
  • Formação superior completa em Comunicação, Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência anterior em mídias sociais, preferencialmente em agências de publicidade e/ou marketing
  • Ter excelente relação interpessoal e gostar de trabalhar em equipe
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com a capacidade de traduzir informações complexas em recomendações claras e concisas.
  • Orientação para resultados, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico.
DIFERENCIAIS
Será um diferencial se você:
  • Tiver conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão como ClickUp, Notion, Trello, Softwares e ferramentas de gestão de projetos
  • Conhecimento de Metodologias Ágeis.
  • Conhecimento de ferramenta de visualização de dados como PowerBi etc.,
ONDE VOCÊ IRÁ TRABALHAR
Aqui na Kife nós somos #RemoteFirst, então você poderá trabalhar de onde quiser, seja do conforto da sua casa ou em nosso escritório ;)
BENEFÍCIOS QUE VOCÊ IRÁ APROVEITAR COM A GENTE

Somos a Alea. A nova marca da Construtora Tenda.

Colocamos a casa dos sonhos ao alcance de quem nem sabia que podia sonhar! Mais do que a casa própria, produzimos um produto inimaginável, com uma proposta de valor diferenciada para o mercado de habitação popular, entregando casas de muita qualidade no modelo de condomínio fechado, com conceito de urbanismo diferenciado.

A gente acredita que dignidade e felicidade é para todos. Por isso, oferecemos condições de pagamento sob medida para todos os bolsos, através da parceria com o Casa Verde e Amarela, parcelas de financiamento menores e taxas de juros reduzidas.

Somos um time de alta performance e nos desafiamos a fazer diferente para alcançar o que parece impossível. Por isso, acreditamos que todos devem e podem inovar. Temos obsessão por eficiência e buscamos o alto desempenho através da abordagem industrial da construção civil, aliada à cultura de melhoria contínua e lifelong learning.

Gostamos de trabalhar de um jeito descomplicado, e valorizamos o jeito simples de ser e agir. O nosso jeito é leve, parceiro e amigo. Aqui nós celebramos nossas conquistas, reconhecemos e valorizamos os talentos que partilham da nossa cultura, entregam resultados consistentes e nos provocam a evoluir. Afinal, são as nossas pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.

Na Elements, acreditamos no poder da coragem . E buscamos pessoas que queiram mais — que sonham grande , que vivem com intenção e que não têm medo de evoluir .

O que você vai construir com a gente:

Quem somos?
Somos uma empresa de produtos de tecnologia corporativa. Temos mais de 15 anos de história e estamos só no começo! Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Confira o que é preciso.

O que é desejável, mas não obrigatório?
  • Experiência com projetos do setor público;
  • Vivência comercial e/ou gestão de contas;
  • Experiência em projetos como fornecedor;
  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional).
O que você irá fazer no seu dia a dia e com o que irá trabalhar?
  • Executar, junto com o time, o projeto buscando garantir os principais pilares (escopo, prazo, custo, etc.);
  • Identificar e solucionar os pontos críticos do projeto, facilitando e removendo impedimentos;

  • Ser responsável pela visão financeira do projeto, buscando as aprovações e realizando os faturamentos.
Se interessou pela SYDLE e pela oportunidade?
Será incrível receber seu currículo e saber do seu interesse pelo nosso time! Cada currículo recebido é avaliado pelo nosso RH e, caso o seu seja selecionado, entraremos em contato convidando para nossa seleção. Então fique de olho no celular e no e-mail, combinado? Mas caso seu currículo não seja selecionado para essa vaga, não se preocupe! Você ficará automaticamente em nosso banco de talentos para oportunidades futuras.
Conte com a SYDLE!
Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas, independente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, classe social ou religião. Queremos crescer juntos e acreditamos que, quanto mais diverso e autêntico for o nosso time, mais rico será o nosso dia a dia. Dessa forma, buscamos ter um olhar diferenciado e cuidadoso para essa pauta nas nossas seleções. E, caso você precise de alguma adaptação especial em nosso processo seletivo ou se tiver dificuldades em custear seu deslocamento para participar das avaliações, conte com a gente e informe o RH ao agendar as etapas.
Confira nossos benefícios!
Necessidades individuais:
Cada colaborador tem uma necessidade única. Há quem tenha família grande e queira todo mundo no plano de saúde ou quem já tenha o plano junto com sua família. description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Transportation Engineer role at Pennoni

Join to apply for the Graduate Transportation Engineer role at Pennoni

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Pennoni is hiring Graduate Civil Engineers to join our Transportation Engineering team on a full-time, direct basis.
We have needs in each of the disciplines listed below.
Job Descriptions
Highway Engineer Job Responsibilities:

  • Participate in the development of engineering design projects, while working in a team environment to produce engineering plans, documents, and reports.
  • Review and apply standard engineering design principles.
  • Implement the use of 3-D modelling software for transportation infrastructure projects while utilizing tools like MicroStation / InRoads or AutoCADD / Civil 3D.
  • Contribute to developing sets of transportation infrastructure plans (including highway design, hydrology, and drainage calculations / design, SWM / E&SC design; water and sanitary sewer utility layout, MOT plans, and geometry, etc.).
  • Support projects / tasks of various sizes for a variety of clients (including state agencies, counties, and local municipalities.)
Highway Engineer Preferred Qualifications
  • Basis understanding of engineering design parameters is a plus.
  • Relevant experience with highway geometry development, water resources design, or overall plan preparation is a plus.
  • Exposure to modeling tools such as OpenRoads is a plus!
  • Experience working with highway and/or roadway design is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with drainage design, stormwater management, and erosion and sediment control; completion of Certified Construction Review (CCR) training is a plus!
  • Exposure to Bluebeam Revu (PDF editor) and/or GIS tools is a plus!
Bridge Engineer Job Responsibilities
  • Assist with the structural analysis and/or design of Bridges (highway & railroad), culverts, retaining walls, and overhead sign structures on a variety of projects (bridge replacement/rehabilitation, highway improvement, etc.); this includes multi-disciplinary projects for various agencies in the Mid-Atlantic region!
  • Supplement the bridge design functions with involvement with the NBIS Bridge inspections discipline across the Pennoni footprint on an as needed basis (with occasional opportunities for domestic travel).
  • Learn and apply professional techniques to produce high-quality engineering documents for use in bridge design / inspection reports, specifications, studies, and other engineering documents.
Bridge Engineer Preferred Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in Civil Engineering with a Structural Engineering focus is a plus!
  • Successful completion of FHWA-NHI-13005 (Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges)
  • Bridge engineering experience with a major agency is a plus.
  • Knowledge of structural analysis programs (e.g.: STAAD, LEAP Bridge, LEAP Concrete, AASHTOWare, BrR, BRASS, SAP/CSI, etc.) is a plus!
Traffic Engineer Job Responsibilities
  • Traffic Engineer needed to join a dynamic team responsible for working with many clients including state agencies, county governments, and local municipalities, for the development of Traffic related projects.
  • Assist with traffic engineering tasks ranging from traffic impact analysis (TIA), safety evaluations, signal analysis and design and the preparation of signing and pavement marking plans, MOT / construction phasing plans, transportation management plans (TMPs), and lighting plans.
  • Assist with traffic study reviews from third parties for new developments and projects.
Traffic Engineer Preferred Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of traffic signal design software (SYNCHRO) is a plus.
  • Exposure to modeling tools such as OpenRoads is a plus!
  • Familiarity with maintenance of traffic schemes, construction phasing, and traffic control plans.
  • Experience with lighting design software is a plus.
Basic Requirement
  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline (e.g.: Structural Engineering, etc.).
Preferred Qualifications
  • E. / E.I.T. is a plus!
  • Established knowledge of civil engineering principles such as development of geometric information, structural analysis, steel/concrete design, basic hydrology/hydraulics, and basic geotechnical/foundation design.
  • Relevant experience with engineering software, such as MicroStation and AutoCAD.
  • Experience and interest in working on various levels of engineering infrastructure projects in the Mid-Atlantic region.
  • Organization and planning ability is a plus.

At Pennoni, we're not just another multi-disciplinary engineering firm; we're a vibrant team of innovators shaping the future! Founded more than five decades ago, Pennoni is an ENR Top 500 consulting engineering firm where individuality sparks innovation and growth. We’re all about helping you build your career while fostering a great workplace culture – here, you'll work with supportive, talented teammates and find pride in your contributions. Join us to be part of a team that values your unique skills and drives excellence in every project!

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro), suporte à equipe e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Assegurar cumprimento de prazos operacionais e proatividade na resolução de intercorrências, implementando melhorias contínuas no monitoramento.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities :

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing CPU and GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

The Company You’ll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.
Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.
As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.
You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.
You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.
The Team You'll Work With
The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.
About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

title: Software-Defined Networking Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Software-Defined Networking Engineer role at Canonical

14 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software-Defined Networking Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This is a general selection process for all seniority levels, to join teams that focus on open source networking software at Canonical. Apply here if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking at any level - from the Linux kernel IP or eBPF and bridge constructs, to overlay SDN networking like OVS and OVN, to router, switch and radio access technologies such as SoNIC, FRR and DENT, all the way up to telco MANO and 5G Core solutions.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimise Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data centre networking, from bare metal through virt, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
If you have a passion for networking technologies, deep familiarity with Linux networking and awareness of open source community best practices, then you will enjoy our software-defined networking role at Canonical. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, OpenStack, LXD, MAAS and MicroK8s across a broad range of devices and use cases.
These roles include:

  • Kernel Networking Software Engineer
  • OVN Software Engineer
  • SmartNIC Software Engineer
  • Top-of-Rack (ToR) Software Engineer
  • SoNIC or DENT Software Engineer
  • Telco Software Engineer
  • Kubernetes Software Engineer
Location: we have networking software engineering roles in every time zone
What your day will look like
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the latest hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Contribute to shape innovative product strategies
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organisation
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data centre architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Deep understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies - kernel (including eBPF, AF_XDP), OVS, OVN, SoNIC, DENT, Switchdev, DPDK, SPDK, 5G 3GPP, ONF stack, iwd, NetworkManager, etc.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Cloud-native Network Functions, and Container Network Interface plugins
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Coordenador(a) de Controladoria
description:
Sobre a Vaga
Buscamos um(a) profissional com visão estratégica e sólida expertise técnica para integrar nossa equipe na posição de Coordenador(a) de Controladoria. Este papel é crucial para a gestão dos processos contábeis e fiscais, o rigoroso controle de custos, o fundamental suporte à auditoria externa e a implementação eficaz de controles internos (SOX). O objetivo é assegurar a máxima acuracidade e transparência das informações financeiras da nossa operação no Brasil, fortalecendo a tomada de decisão e a conformidade.
Principais Responsabilidades
Como Coordenador(a) de Controladoria, você será responsável por

  • Liderar e otimizar os processos de fechamento contábil e de apuração de custos mensalmente, garantindo a precisão e o cumprimento de prazos.
  • Elaborar e revisar criteriosamente as demonstrações financeiras e os relatórios gerenciais, atendendo às exigências internas e às diretrizes da matriz.
  • Conduzir e prestar suporte qualificado durante os processos de auditoria externa, tanto trimestrais quanto anuais, facilitando o acesso às informações e esclarecendo questionamentos.
  • Executar e supervisionar as conciliações contábeis e fiscais, identificando oportunidades e implementando melhorias contínuas para aumentar a eficiência e a confiabilidade dos processos.
  • Monitorar e assegurar a estrita conformidade com a matriz de controles internos (SOX), mitigando riscos e promovendo a integridade dos dados financeiros.
  • Prestar assessoria especializada às demais áreas da empresa sobre os registros e transações que possam impactar as demonstrações financeiras, promovendo a correta aplicação das normas.
  • Participar ativamente do ciclo orçamentário, desde a elaboração até o acompanhamento das variações, fornecendo análises e insights valiosos.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto de contato e facilitador entre a matriz e a operação local para todos os assuntos relacionados à controladoria, garantindo alinhamento e comunicação eficaz.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, com registro profissional (CRC) ativo e regularizado
  • Experiência consolidada e comprovada em posições de liderança na área contábil, como Contador(a) Chefe, ou uma trajetória significativa em empresas de auditoria Big Four, atuando em nível sênior.
  • Profundo domínio das normas contábeis brasileiras (BRGAAP) e internacionais (IFRS), bem como da complexa legislação tributária vigente no Brasil.
  • Vivência prática e substancial com processos de auditoria externa e com a implementação e manutenção de controles internos, especialmente sob a metodologia SOX.
  • Conhecimento avançado e proficiente nas ferramentas Microsoft Excel Avançado e no sistema de gestão integrada SAP (módulos FI/CO).
  • Fluência avançada em espanhol ou inglês, permitindo comunicação eficaz com equipes internacionais e a matriz.
  • Um perfil marcadamente analítico, orientado para a entrega de resultados com excelência, demonstrando alta capacidade de organização, planejamento e resiliência para atuar sob pressão e cumprir prazos desafiadores.
Requisitos desejáveis
  • Pós-graduação/MBA em Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (ex Power BI)
  • Experiência no Agronegócio ou Indústria.
Beneficios
Fazer parte de uma empresa dinâmica que se encontra em um grande processo de mudança e expansão. Contratação efetiva, treinamento contínuo e o atraente pacote de benefícios, como
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Bônus Anual;
  • WellHub;
  • Dayoff;
  • Bônus por casamento;
  • Cesta de Natal;
  • Kit Escolar;
  • Plataforma de desenvolvimento;
  • E muito mais...
Somos un equipo que busca crecer juntos. Promovemos la innovación, la calidad y el compromiso como pilares para llegar al mundo con biotecnologías pensados para impulsar una mejor agricultura.
Nuestras propuestas están diseñadas para proteger, estimular y nutrir desde la presiembra y durante todo el ciclo de crecimiento de las plantas. Lideramos el mercado global de biotecnología agrícola con un portafolio de soluciones que permiten mayores rindes, con una menor huella ambiental.
Inspiramos a las personas a que lleven adelante sus ideas y las compartan. Nos enriquecemos con una mirada diversa e inclusiva que, sin dudas, genera resultados extraordinarios.
Somos desafío permanente. Buscamos respuestas que vayan de la mano de la sustentabilidad pensando en las futuras generaciones.
¡Unite a nosotros para ser parte de esta experiencia única!

title: Ler Inscrições abertas para o Programa de Trainee 2021 da Nestlé Brasil
description:
Inscrições abertas para o Programa de Trainee 2021 da Nestlé Brasil

Estão abertas, até 18 de outubro, as inscrições para o Programa de Trainee 2021 da Nestlé Brasil, disponíveis pelo site . O processo será conduzido de forma totalmente digital e à distância, tanto para atender critérios de saúde e segurança exigidos pela situação atual quanto para democratizar o acesso à iniciativa. Como em anos anteriores, a iniciativa está aberta para candidatos de todo o Brasil.

Em linha com as demandas de um público jovem cada vez mais ligado e atento à importância do propósito na atuação de profissionais e empresas, o Programa da Nestlé este ano terá como mote #EvoluirJuntosFazBem e será conectado com o propósito da companhia, que é revelar o poder dos alimentos para melhorar a qualidade de vida de todos, hoje e para as próximas gerações. Isso será feito tendo como base os três pilares que guiam a atuação da companhia para a geração de valor compartilhado: Indivíduos e Famílias, Comunidade e Planeta.

Como resposta a um cenário em que os jovens têm que lidar com um futuro incerto e desafiador no mercado de trabalho devido à pandemia, além de incertezas em relação à conclusão de estudos e ao início de suas carreiras, a iniciativa trará, ao longo de suas etapas, capacitação em inteligência emocional, saúde mental, dicas de nutrição e qualidade de vida, entre outros temas. O objetivo é que todos os inscritos saiam do programa com algum aprendizado, por isso desde o início serão disponibilizadas pílulas com informações para atingir todos que se inscreverem.

Após a etapa de inscrições, o processo seguirá com testes online, dinâmica de grupo, painel virtual, entrevistas online e etapa final. Todas as fases levam em consideração o conceito de gamificação e a etapa final trará desafios baseadas em cases reais da companhia, pensando em soluções com olhar voltado para a inovação. O processo envolverá diferentes tecnologias para fazer com que o candidato, mesmo à distância, consiga entender como é fazer parte da Nestlé e conheça um pouco mais da empresa.

É a maior empresa de alimentos e bebidas do mundo. Está presente em 190 países e seus 308 mil colaboradores estão comprometidos com o propósito da Nestlé de melhorar a qualidade de vida e contribuir para um futuro mais saudável.

A Nestlé oferece um amplo portfólio de produtos e serviços para cada etapa de vida das pessoas e de seus animais de estimação. Suas mais de 2000 marcas variam dos ícones globais, como Nescafé ou Nespresso aos favoritos locais como Ninho. O desempenho da empresa é impulsionado por sua estratégia de Nutrição, Saúde e Bem-Estar. Sua Sede fica na cidade suíça de Vevey, onde foi fundada há mais de 150 anos. No Brasil, instalou a primeira fábrica em 1921, na cidade paulista de Araras, para a produção do leite condensado Milkmaid, que mais tarde seria conhecido como Leite Moça. A empresa tem unidades industriais localizadas nos Estados de São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Pernambuco, Goiás, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul e Espírito Santo. Emprega 32 mil colaboradores diretos e gera outros 200 mil empregos indiretos.

A Nestlé Brasil está presente em 99% dos lares brasileiros, segundo pesquisa realizada pela Kantar Worldpanel.

title: Trainer - Logistics & Supply Chain
description:
Position Summary:

We are looking for a highly skilled Logistics Trainer to develop and deliver training programs that enhance the training and content effectiveness of our global logistics operations. The ideal candidate will have expertise in international trade regulations, supply chain management, and logistics best practices to ensure our teams operate effectively in a fast-moving global environment.

As a Trainer, you will be primarily responsible for creating content and conducting trainings. The role of a Trainer requires you to take complete ownership of training activities while looking at ways to continually improve and increase the value of the program.


Training & Development Responsibilities:
  • Design and implement training programs for logistics personnel across multiple regions.
  • Conduct new hire training programs as per the training agenda and ensure timely completion of trainings.
  • Design training modules and update materials, manuals, SOPs, playbooks, checklists, and visual aids that align with international logistics practices.
  • Manage the training program in accordance with business needs, regulatory requirements; ensure compliance with global trade regulations and customs requirements.
  • Stay updated on global trade policies and integrate them into training programs and training content.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to address skill gaps and enhance training efficiency.
  • Analyze supply chain data to identify training areas or documents for improvement.
  • Evaluate trainees for the duration of the training by administering regular assessments and activities followed by a feedback process.
  • Conduct workshops and hands-on training on supply chain optimization, transportation, and inventory management.
  • Provide guidance on risk management and regulatory compliance in logistics operations.
  • Check all logistical requirements (e.g., training room booking, desks, etc.) before beginning a program to ensure smooth and efficient implementation.
  • Prepare training reports; track training effectiveness with details of challenges if any.
Qualifications/Experience:
  • 3+ years of experience in logistics and supply chain management in a global environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field
  • Excellent knowledge of international shipping regulations & customs procedures, knowledge of global import/export legislative requirements
  • Proficiency in logistics software (SAP, Ariba, etc.) and Google Office Suite
  • Strong expertise in creating training documentation such as playbooks, standard operating procedures, training presentations, business reviews, etc.
  • Good presentation and communication skills
  • Good people-handling skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills
  • Excellent eye for detail, analytical and problem-solving abilities
Work Environment:
  • Fast-paced, global supply chain operations
  • Collaboration with international teams and vendors
  • Requires adaptability to different time zones and cultural business practices
  • Willingness to travel to support training or project-related activities

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

Da soma de todos os colaboradores que compõem nossos times, nascem nossos valores e visão de mundo. Day off de aniversário: Uma folga para você comemorar o seu dia;

Assistência Odontológica Amil: Com ampla cobertura nacional, a adesão do plano é opcional;

Convênio com empresas parceiras: Parcerias exclusivas para oferecer vantagens que fazem a diferença no dia a dia;

️ Acesso aos nosso Museus: Acesso gratuito aos nossos equipamentos culturais para você e sua família/amigos.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais.Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CultSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual,Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um.Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus.Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Description
Esta é uma posição de colaborador individual, com base em nosso escritório de São Paulo. Procuramos uma pessoa dinâmica, analítica, inovadora, orientada para a prática e com foco inabalável no cliente.
Na Amazon, nosso objetivo é exceder as expectativas dos clientes, garantindo que seus pedidos sejam entregues com máxima rapidez, precisão e eficiência de custo. A determinação da rota de cada pacote é realizada por sistemas complexos, que precisam acompanhar o crescimento acelerado e a complexidade da malha logística no Brasil. Diante desse cenário, a equipe de Otimização de Supply Chain está à procura de um cientista de dados experiente, capaz de desenvolver modelos, ferramentas e processos para garantir confiabilidade, agilidade, eficiência de custos e a melhor utilização dos ativos.
O candidato ideal terá sólidas habilidades quantitativas e experiência com conjuntos de dados complexos, sendo capaz de identificar tendências, inovar processos e tomar decisões baseadas em dados, considerando a cadeia de suprimentos de ponta a ponta.
Key job responsibilities

  • Executar projetos de melhoria contínua na malha logística através de análise efetiva de métricas de desempenho e indicadores chave, aproveitando boas práticas internacionais.
  • Desenvolver e unificar relatórios para gerenciamento proativo de exceções e visibilidade das operações logísticas.
  • Criar ferramentas de auditoria e relatórios consolidados para identificar gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Automatizar processos manuais e implementar ferramentas de autoatendimento para aumentar a produtividade da equipe.
  • Auditar operações, configurações sistêmicas e processos através de mecanismos aprimorados de análise para melhor visibilidade dos indicadores que impactam custos e velocidade de entregas.
  • Realizar benchmarks internacionais para identificar melhores práticas em análise de dados e processos avançados, adaptando-os às operações locais.
About The Team
Nosso time é composto por engenheiros de dados, gerentes de projetos e cientistas de dados, todos dedicados a criar soluções escaláveis e inovadoras que suportem e otimizem as operações logísticas da Amazon no Brasil. Nossa missão é garantir a eficiência de todas as etapas da cadeia de suprimentos, desde a primeira até a última milha, ajudando a Amazon a entregar resultados com agilidade, precisão e a um custo competitivo, especialmente em um ambiente de rápido crescimento e complexidade.
Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree;
  • Advanced SQL expertise including complex queries, data manipulation, and ETL processes, with ability to build and maintain data infrastructure;
  • Proficiency in visualization tools (Tableau, QuickSight, Power BI) to create impactful data presentations and dashboards for business stakeholders;
  • Advanced English.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc;
  • Knowledge of AWS tech stack (e.g., AWS Redshift, S3, EC2, Glue);
  • Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team;
  • Experience in optimization models for logistic.

Paragon Forensics is a leading full-service consulting firm specialized in providing forensic analysis and expert opinion to the legal and insurance industries. Our principal services include analyses of accident reconstruction, premises liability, biomechanics, and safety to assist our clients in their evaluation of actual or potential injury-related claims. We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists who collaborate on cases in a relaxed yet fast-paced work environment.

Job Description:

The Senior Level Accident Reconstruction and/or Biomechanical Expert is expected to be a lead consultant on forensic cases pertaining to personal injury lawsuits or claims. This role will include responsibility for client/case acquisition, case management, review and analysis of file material, performance of inspections, and collaboration with support staff. As the lead consultant on cases, this position requires providing expert testimony through depositions, arbitration and trials, as well as writing reports and declarations. Additionally, this engineer will be responsible for the design, implementation, analysis, and publication of novel research relevant to the industry. This position may also involve supporting other cases which Paragon staff are working on. The Senior Level Expert is expected to assist in training and developing other Paragon staff.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Accident Reconstruction role includes, but is not limited to, analyses of motor vehicle incidents to assess questions regarding liability and impact severity, including cases involving heavy trucks, motorcycles, pedestrians, bicycles/scooters, etc. The engineer is expected to be well-versed in inspection of vehicles and incident sites including acquisition of available vehicle data. The Accident Reconstruction expert should understand and perform photogrammetry and videogrammetry analyses to analyze spatial and dynamic conditions depicted in photographs and videos. The expert is expected to perform collision reconstruction simulations through software such as PC-Crash.

The Senior Biomechanics role includes, but is not limited to, analyses of human / vehicle-occupant kinematics, forces applied to an individual in an incident, and injury risk. The expert is expected to be well-verse in mechanism of injury, injury tolerances, and analysis of the exposure applied to an individual. A strong understanding of biomechanical literature and research foundational to these analyses is required.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.
Hoje, temos orgulho em ser um dos principais bancos do Brasil. O motivo disso é incentivar e acreditar no empreendedor brasileiro, fortalecendo relacionamentos apoiados na ética e no respeito. Um dos fatores que nos destacam no mercado é o comprometimento dos nossos colaboradores, com forte espírito empreendedor e uma paixão que os fazem vestir a camisa como se fossem donos. É essa mesma motivação que nos leva a prêmios e conquistas notáveis, como o de Melhor Banco do Brasil, em um ranking realizado pela Forbes, no ano de 2023.
Por aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Acreditamos que sempre podemos melhorar, aprender, investir e buscar o novo. A melhora contínua é um processo diário. Em 2011, inauguramos uma nova categoria de serviços bancários no Brasil, lançando o primeiro banco digital de investimentos: o Sofisa Direto. Com isso, encontramos a oportunidade ideal para manter os nossos clientes motivados a buscar os seus objetivos. Em toda a história, os negócios do Banco Sofisa foram construídos por uma sólida estrutura financeira, assegurada por altos índices de capitalização, fazendo com que os nossos clientes sintam-se seguros, investindo em ativos de qualidade, que muitas das vezes só se encontram por aqui.
Hoje, podemos dizer que vencemos o maior de todos os testes, o teste do tempo. E se esse teste foi vencido, é porque valorizamos quem realmente importa: você, nosso cliente. Cada obstáculo superado, cada desafio vencido são os fundamentos da solidez e a experiência que precisamos para seguir em frente.

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

RAPP is seeking a Junior Art Director who is eager to grow their creative skills and bring fresh thinking to every project. In this role, you will assist in creating visually compelling designs and concepts across multiple media platforms while learning from and collaborating with senior creatives. This is an opportunity to push boundaries, develop your craft, and contribute to impactful campaigns.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Comprehension : Understand the basics of a creative brief and ask questions for clarity when needed.
  • Ideation : Contribute initial ideas and concepts to solve creative challenges.
  • Craft & Execution : Continuously improve design skills and learn to execute work with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Iteration & Elevation : Explore multiple approaches to solving creative challenges and strive to elevate your work.
  • Directing & Managing : Begin to manage your workflow and learn the agency’s processes.
  • Storytelling & Selling : Present ideas internally and collaborate with the team to refine and "sell" the work.
  • Business Contribution : Show a proactive, “how can I help” attitude and deliver work efficiently on time.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in developing creative concepts and designs that align with client goals and strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior art directors, designers, and copywriters to execute visually impactful creative campaigns.
  • Create layouts, comps, and designs for various media, including digital, print, social, and more.
  • Adapt design concepts to meet brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions to contribute fresh and innovative ideas.
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and technologies, applying them to your work.
  • Manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines, ensuring all work is polished and ready for presentation.
  • Learn and follow internal processes, from briefing to delivery.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

  • Contribute fresh ideas and designs that elevate creative campaigns.
  • Clear and open communication with team members, fostering collaboration and trust.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality work on time and on brief.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn and grow through feedback and mentorship.
  • Stay curious and proactive in exploring new design trends and techniques.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience : 0-2 years of experience in art direction or graphic design, with a portfolio showcasing creative work.
  • Design Craft : Strong foundation in typography, layout, and composition.
  • Technical Proficiency :
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) .
  • Familiarity with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch , with the ability to learn, use, and master these tools quickly.
  • Basic knowledge of Keynote, PowerPoint, or Google Slides is a plus.
  • Curiosity about experimenting with AI tools and emerging design technologies.
  • Collaboration : A team player who thrives in a supportive and inclusive environment.
  • Adaptability : Eager to learn, open to feedback, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Our Hybrid Work Model:

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.
