Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation across the entire AI lifecycle by developing and implementing rigorous evaluation frameworks and benchmark methodologies for pre-training, post-training, and inference. Your work will focus on designing metrics and assessment strategies that ensure our models are highly responsive, efficient, and reliable across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in advanced model architectures, pre-training and post-training practices, and inference evaluation frameworks. Adopting a hands-on, research-driven approach, you will develop, test, and implement novel evaluation strategies that rigorously track key performance indicators such as accuracy, latency, throughput, and memory footprint. Your evaluations will not only benchmark model performance at each stage, from the foundational pre-training phase to targeted post-training refinements and final inference but will also provide actionable insights.

A key element of this role is collaborating with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, and operations to share your evaluation findings and integrate stakeholder feedback. You will engineer robust evaluation pipelines and performance dashboards that serve as a common reference point for all stakeholders, ensuring that the insights drive continuous improvement in model deployment strategies. The ultimate goal is to set industry-leading standards for AI model quality and reliability, delivering scalable performance and tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities :

  • Develop, test, and deploy integrated frameworks that rigorously assess models during pre-training, post-training, and inference. Define and track key performance indicators such as accuracy, loss metrics, latency, throughput, and memory footprint across diverse deployment scenarios.

  • Curate high-quality evaluation datasets and design standardized benchmarks to reliably measure model quality and robustness. Ensure that these benchmarks accurately reflect improvements achieved through both pre-training and post-training processes, and drive consistency in evaluation practices.

  • Engage with product management, engineering, data science, and operations teams to align evaluation metrics with business objectives. Present evaluation findings, actionable insights, and recommendations through comprehensive dashboards and reports that support decision-making across functions.

  • Systematically analyze evaluation data to identify and resolve bottlenecks across the model lifecycle. Propose and implement optimizations that enhance model performance, scalability, and resource utilization on resource-constrained platforms, ensuring efficient pre-training, post-training, and inference.

  • Conduct iterative experiments and empirical research to refine evaluation methodologies, staying abreast of emerging techniques and trends. Leverage insights to continuously enhance benchmarking practices and improve overall model reliability, ensuring that all stages of the model lifecycle deliver measurable value in real-world applications.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Demonstrated experience in designing and evaluating AI models at multiple stages from pre-training, post-training, and inference. You should be proficient in developing evaluation frameworks that rigorously assess accuracy, convergence, loss improvements, and overall model robustness, ensuring each stage of the AI lifecycle delivers measurable real-world value.

  • Strong programming skills and hands-on expertise in evaluation benchmarks and frameworks are essential. Familiarity with building, automating, and scaling complex evaluation and benchmarking pipelines, and experience with performance metrics: latency, throughput, and memory footprint.

  • Proven ability to conduct iterative experiments and empirical research that drive the continuous refinement of evaluation methodologies. You should be adept at staying abreast of emerging trends and techniques, leveraging insights to enhance benchmarking practices and model reliability.

  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with diverse teams such as product, engineering, and operations in order to align evaluation strategies with organizational goals. You must be skilled at translating technical findings into actionable insights for stakeholders and driving process improvements across the model development lifecycle.

title: Senior Art Director
description:
RAPP Dallas is looking for a Senior Art Director to join our award-winning Creative team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As aglobal, next-generation precision marketing agencywe leveragedata, creativity, technology, and empathyto foster client growth.We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

RAPP is seeking a Senior Art Director who brings strong conceptual thinking, elevated design skills, and the ability to lead projects through execution. In this role, you will drive the creative process, mentor junior team members, and collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and impactful campaigns. You will push boundaries, elevate creative work, and set the bar for design excellence.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Comprehension : Thoughtfully question briefs and help clarify objectives with an informed understanding of the client’s business and the creative ask.
  • Ideation : Self-start on ideation and lead brainstorming sessions with junior team members to inspire fresh, inclusive ideas.
  • Craft & Execution : Consistently deliver polished, flawless designs that demonstrate mastery of typography, layout, and composition.
  • Iteration & Elevation : Provide multiple, well-considered solutions to creative challenges and push beyond the brief when appropriate.
  • Directing & Managing : Manage your workflow effectively while mentoring and guiding junior team members to produce their best work.
  • Storytelling & Selling : Confidently present your concepts and designs to internal teams and clients, articulating the strategy and creative vision behind the work.
  • Business Contribution : Approach creative challenges with a business mindset, delivering work that drives results for both clients and the agency.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the development of creative concepts and designs that align with client goals and strategies across multiple media platforms (digital, social, print, etc.).
  • Collaborate with copywriters, designers, and other cross-functional team members to deliver cohesive, impactful campaigns.
  • Translate strategic objectives into visually compelling designs that adhere to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries.
  • Mentor junior art directors and designers, providing constructive feedback to help them grow their skills and confidence.
  • Present work to internal teams and clients with clarity and confidence, incorporating feedback as needed to refine the final product.
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and technologies, and proactively apply them to enhance creative outcomes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing timelines and priorities to meet deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Refine and elevate the design process, ensuring efficiency and consistency across all creative deliverables.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

  • Delivery of exceptional creative work that meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Clear and effective communication with team members and clients, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Consistent mentorship and support for junior team members, contributing to their growth and development.
  • Proactive exploration of design trends and tools, with a focus on incorporating them into creative solutions.
  • Efficient management of deliverables, ensuring work is on time, on brand, and on brief.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience : 4+ years of art direction experience, with a portfolio showcasing produced work across digital, print, and social media.
  • Design Craft : Mastery of typography, layout, color theory, and composition, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Technical Proficiency :
    • Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) .
    • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch is a must .
    • Experience with PowerPoint, Keynote, and Adobe Acrobat is a bonus.
    • Curiosity about experimenting with AI tools and emerging design technologies.
  • Leadership : Ability to mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a culture of collaboration and creativity.
  • Communication : Confident and persuasive presentation skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • Adaptability : Thrive under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver exceptional work in a fast-paced environment.

Our Hybrid Work Model:

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

RAPP provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Healthcare & Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts, vacation, sick, and personal days and positive activism days, paid parental leave and disability benefits. For more information regarding Omnicom benefits, please visit . A reasonable estimate of the salary for this role, at the time of posting, is $72,000 - $94,000. This range is specific to Dallas and multiple factors are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to: skill set, experience and training, certifications; etc. This is an exempt position. If your requirements fall outside of this range, you are still welcome to apply.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

title: Senior GRC Analyst
description:
Area The Engineering team at Tractian is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge infrastructure, technologies, and products to harness the power of IoT data. Our team of talented Engineers collaborates to build robust systems, innovative solutions, and scalable platforms that drive Tractian's success. We are instrumental in shaping the company's decision-making process, optimizing operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional experiences to our consumers.
What you will do As a GRC Analyst, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) practices within our technology-driven organization. You will play a key role in establishing frameworks and processes that ensure the security, integrity, and regulatory compliance of our technology systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risks, implement controls, and drive continuous improvement of our GRC program.

Responsibilities

  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform Business Impact Analysis (BIA), mapping processes and identifying RTO and RPO.
  • Conduct the identification, mapping, assessment, and management of both operational and strategic risks across the organization, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Keep all the BCP and Disaster Recovery documents up to date.
  • Develop, implement, and update company-wide compliance processes, procedures and rules to ensure alignment with corporate goals, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Collaborate with other departments to create and modify operational processes and agreements and execute actions from action plans.
  • Conduct and document regular tests for recovery, continuity plans (disaster recovery exercise, backup & data recovery, etc.) also supporting incident response tests.
  • Implement privacy controls following the company’s governance guidelines and LGPD, GDPR, and CCPA regulations.
  • Support the continuous improvement of compliance with ISO 27001, 27002, 22301 and 22313 standards.
  • Monitor and conduct assessments to ensure the effectiveness of internal controls, also implementing improvements considering audits and assessments reports.
  • Collaborate with multiple departments and headquarters to ensure effective implementation of compliance programs and provide guidance on risk-related matters to leadership.
  • Collaborate to clarify security maturity doubts with stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Background in IT, security, auditing, compliance and/or quality.
  • Experience with BCP-DR based on ISO 22301 and ISO 22313, including development of procedures, execution, and documentation of tests.
  • Experience with audits and assessments of ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Hands-on experience in executing action plans and implementing controls.
  • Knowledge with risk management frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST etc.).
  • Knowledge of privacy laws (LGPD, CCPA, GDPR, etc.)
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Would be a plus:

  • Certification related to ISO 27001 and/or privacy (e.g., EXIN or IAPP).
  • Experience in using Business Continuity Management (BCM) tools.
  • Experiences with Vanta, SAT platforms, EDR, MDM, IAM.
  • Other compliance/security certifications.

Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em

O que procuramos?
Atribuições Principais
Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em gestão de mudança organizacional (Change Management) para atuar nas ações do ciclo de Planejamento Estratégico de Tecnologia (TI 2030), com foco inicial nas iniciativas de evolução da resiliência digital da empresa. Esta posição exige forte capacidade de articulação com stakeholders, visão sistêmica, habilidade de comunicação com alta liderança e domínio na criação de materiais executivos e instrumentos de monitoramento do sucesso da mudança; além de experiência em cenários de transformação tecnológica (ex: adoção de DevSecOps, Agilidade, etc) em cenários de ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais fim a fim.
Escopo do Programa
O programa de Resiliência Digital visa elevar a maturidade tecnológica da organização, atuando nas seguintes frentes:

  • Redução de débito técnico e obsolescência;
  • Tratamento de vulnerabilidades tecnológicas;
  • Evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;

  • Implantação e adoção de plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (IDP) com consequente evolução no modelo operacional de tecnologia;

Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de mudança em programas de transformação digital, tecnológica ou organizacional.
  • Atuação com públicos técnicos (ex: engenharia, segurança, arquitetura) e não técnicos (ex: negócio, liderança).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks como PROSCI/ADKAR, Lean Change ou similares.
  • Habilidade comprovada em produção de apresentações executivas para níveis gerenciais e C-level.
  • Experiência na criação de indicadores para monitoramento da mudança e tomada de decisão.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes ágeis, DevOps e práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software.
Habilidades Comportamentais Esperadas
  • Comunicação clara, empatia e escuta ativa.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas técnicos em linguagem acessível e influenciar diferentes perfis de stakeholders.
  • Organização e disciplina para atuação em múltiplas frentes simultâneas.
  • Proatividade e autonomia, com foco em entregas de alto impacto.
  • Possuir visão sistêmica de estruturas e processos de tecnologia.
  • Visão estratégica, poder de síntese com capacidade de executar no detalhe.
Diferenciais
  • Certificações: PROSCI, PMP, Agile Change, Lean Change Management.
  • Experiência com métricas de sucesso em programas de transformação.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de colaboração e produtividade digital.
Localidade Da Posição
Porque construir sua carreira na Meta?
Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA
Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Senior Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineer
description:
Job Description

At IPS, you will apply your knowledge, skills, and passion to make a difference in the lives of people, solving complex challenges related to pharmaceutical, biotech, and animal health research and manufacturing facilities. We are looking for a talented Senior Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineer to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.


In this role, you will work independently on various projects as assigned by a Project Manager or group leader. You will also play a role in the entire design process including but not limited to preliminary assessments, concept creation, design, problem resolution, and customer and vendor accessibility. Additionally, you may work on several concurrent projects and at times may assist as a technical expert on a specialized design. Fluency in English is mandatory
What You'll Do

  • Assign and review the work of the project design team.
  • Check the progress of work and alert the Project Manager to changes in scope or additional services.
  • Attend pre-bid meetings and assist the project team in evaluating commercial proposals.
  • Assess the requirements of a project, break a project into tasks, and work with a Project Manager to determine the scope of work, budget, and staffing.
  • Write the scope of work for plumbing and fire protection designs based on preliminary reviews and meetings with the clients.
  • Develop design concepts and prepare documents during the design development phase.
  • Correct and update design documents.
  • Develops solutions to design problems.
  • Prepare engineering studies and schematic designs for new systems and analyze the operation of existing systems.
  • Use computer-aided design technologies to develop sketches, drawings, and construction documents.
  • Review drawings and documents to ensure compliance with company design and production standards.
  • Work with equipment suppliers/vendors to obtain the necessary information needed for design completion.
  • Interacts with clients regularly to secure scope and design intent.
  • Ensure acceptable levels of quality and check for coordination of work to ensure documents reflect design intent and necessary coordination.
  • Coordinate all aspects of project document completion within the company and externally with clients and other design professionals.
  • Coordinate design work with related engineering disciplines.
  • Attend job and construction meetings and participate in the coordination of the work.
  • Contribute to annual performance reviews for assigned staff.
  • Assist in the education and development of design staff and act as a resource for design questions.

Come join a caring, nimble team that delivers world-class designs for our pharmaceutical clients and take your career to new heights!


Qualifications & Requirements
  • 10+ years of previous Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineering and Design experience.
  • Bachelor of Engineering Degree from an accredited University.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE).
  • Has previous experience working for an Architectural and Engineering firm (A&E).
  • Is proficient in the use of computers for design and understands CAD operations.
  • Has knowledge of all aspects of plumbing and fire protection systems; including Sanitary and Vent Systems, Storm Systems, Process Waste Systems, Lab and Vent Systems, Domestic Water Systems, Process and Lab Gas Systems, Sprinkler Design, and Wet/Dry/Pre Action Systems.
  • Is able to produce calculations for the above systems.
  • Has a demonstrated ability to manage projects, problem solve, and communicate effectively to all key personnel and time manage.
  • Able to travel up to 25%.
  • Must have more than 5 years’ experience in pharmaceutical projects
  • Must be fluent in English
  • Must have experience in Revit, AutoCad plant 3D

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in process industries, particularly in the Life Sciences sector (pharmaceutical, biotech, or similar).
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) to support teams in Brazil and the USA.
  • Strong understanding of international codes and standards (e.g., ASME, ANSI, NFPA).

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. IPS, inclusive of its Enterprise entities, has over 3,500 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.   • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Job description

Será responsável por estruturar, aprimorar e garantir a conformidade dos processos de governança, alinhando TI as necessidades do negócio e assegurar a aderência às melhores práticas e normas regulatórias. O candidato ideal deve possuir uma vasta experiência de mercado, sólida bagagem em governança de TI, frameworks como COBIT, ITIL e CGEIT, além de forte visão estratégica e capacidade de influência em todos os níveis da organização.

#LI-DR1

Main responsibilities

  • Liderar e estruturar a estratégia de Governança de TI, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio;
  • Atuar fortemente em todas as dimensões de governança;
  • Ter conhecimento aprofundado em práticas de Governança de Tecnologia;
  • Definir e implementar políticas, processos e controles baseados em boas práticas de mercado;
  • Elaborar e conduzir plano de ação para resolução de problemas que impactam na elevação de maturidade de processos avaliados, zelando pelo progresso e pela completude das iniciativas;
  • Gerenciar e monitorar a gestão de riscos de TI, assegurando a conformidade regulatória e mitigação de vulnerabilidades;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de performance e conformidade para medir a efetividade da governança;
  • Colaborar com diversas áreas do negócio para garantir que as práticas de governança de TI sejam integradas à estratégia corporativa;
  • Promover uma cultura de governança e compliance dentro da TI, garantindo a adesão a processos e políticas estabelecidas.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Governança de TI, Gestão de Riscos e Compliance;
  • Conhecimento profundo em frameworks como COBIT, ITIL e CGEIT;
  • Experiência na implementação e monitoramento de controles internos e conformidade regulatória;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com stakeholders de diferentes áreas, influenciando e garantindo a aderência às práticas de governança;
  • Experiência em auditorias de TI, gerenciamento de riscos e políticas de segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos e fornecedores de TI será um diferencial;
  • Certificações como COBIT e ITIL são altamente desejáveis.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer
description:
Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

122493

About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. Our ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) team turns customer data into practical business solutions to drive the implementation of our ambitious customer strategy.

If you are a talented, dynamic and experienced Data Analyst, passionate about connecting the dots and have a strong background in technology, we would love to hear from you.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work with us.

The opportunity: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities will include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data to identify trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. Additionally, you will be key to ensure that project objectives align with business goals, and will lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Understands customers objectives, processes and products in order to make appropriate recommendations for customer-specific needs during incubation, delivery and operations
  • Plans, conducts and facilitates incubation sessions for business requirements gathering with subject matter experts and end users ensuring deliverables are met
  • Adapts and applies different delivery methodologies determining the best methodology for the specific project
  • Contributes to business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Produces requirement specifications and outlines solution design documents throughout the project life cycle, incorporating change requests and finalization of requirements documentation
  • Analyzes and manages requirement risk, traceability matrix and prioritizes requirements
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Participates in development of test plan, testing, implementation and training activities
  • Participates in post implementation activities including problem solving and measurement of benefits achieved
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels
  • Creates compelling project documents such as business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Manages interdependencies within the projects and other functions
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or science or a related field, any higher degree is an advantage
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Balanced mix of business acumen as well as affinity to technology and systems
  • Innovative and creative self-starter, highly motivated, business and IT savvy
  • Independent and able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Must possess in-depth, strong problem-solving analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Experience in the delivery of business solutions in time, quality, and budget
  • Proven experience as business analyst or subject matter expert in global projects and/or sound knowledge in insurance business
  • Proven track with project management & software development methodologies (e.g. Agile, SCRUM, ITIL, PMP)
  • Tough-minded, highly flexible and determine to deliver assigned targets
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Experience in application testing and organizing user acceptance testing
  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork
  • Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required, Spanish language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

Zurich not providing relocation nor work permit assistance for these particular roles.

A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil.   • Vivência no mercado B2B em empresas de serviços ou financeiras.

  • Capacidade para estruturar, implementar e gerir ações de crescimento com ajustes rápidos de rota para direcionar performance.

  • Elaborar cronogramas, acompanhar e apresentar projetos.

Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas de refrigeração, zelando pela guarda, conservação, manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais utilizados, bem como do local de trabalho, garantindo o correto descarte de resíduos de materiais do local de trabalho.


Main responsibilities

  • Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas de refrigeração, zelando pela guarda, conservação, manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e materiais utilizados, bem como do local de trabalho.

  • Auxiliar na manutenção e instalação de ar-condicionado em toda planta industrial.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva do sistema de refrigeração, ventilação e tubulações.
  • Auxiliar e executar, sob supervisão, em caso de adequações necessárias para o perfeito funcionamento dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo o correto descarte de resíduos de materiais do local de trabalho.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios das atividades realizadas pelo Plano de Manutenção Operação e Controle (PMOC).
  • Executar outras atividades inerentes ao cargo, conforme solicitação do superior imediato
  • Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente do trabalho, estabelecidos pela organização, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs de uso obrigatório no desenvolvimento das atividades do cargo e do setor. Tendo a tresponsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho.
  • Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e processos da empresa, sempre focando nas metas organizacionais, e mantendo sigilo e protegendo as informações da companhia.
  • Manter a disciplina no programa 5S, objetivando um trabalho seguro por meio da manutenção da organização, padronização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Zelar pelas propriedades da empresa sob sua responsabilidade, informando ao superior imediato qualquer problema ou avaria detectada.

Experiência na função.

description:
Procuramos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para integrar nosso time de Soluções IA e contribuir com o desenvolvimento de análises avançadas, modelos preditivos e algoritmos que impactem diretamente objetivos estratégicos de nossos clientes.
Esta pessoa terá um papel relevante na aplicação de machine learning e inteligência artificial, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares para transformar dados em soluções acionáveis e de alto valor para o negócio. A posição está aberta para profissionais com diferentes níveis de experiência, desde quem está iniciando na área até quem já possui trajetória consolidada.
Se você possui paixão por ciência de dados, inovação e busca um ambiente desafiador e dinâmico, queremos conhecer você!
Responsabilidades:

  • Integrar ou liderar projetos de ciência de dados, desde a identificação de problemas de negócios até a entrega de soluções analíticas que gerem impacto mensurável.
  • Criar, implementar e manter modelos preditivos e soluções de machine learning, utilizando grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias, fornecendo insights estratégicos e recomendações baseadas em dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão.
  • Colaborar com equipes de engenharia de dados, produto e negócios para integrar modelos e algoritmos aos sistemas e fluxos operacionais.
  • Pesquisar e implementar novas técnicas, ferramentas e frameworks em machine learning e inteligência artificial, acompanhando tendências de mercado e tecnologia.
  • Compartilhar boas práticas com o time, promovendo uma cultura de excelência técnica e colaboração.
  • Garantir que as soluções entregues sejam escaláveis, interpretáveis e alinhadas às melhores práticas de ciência de dados e engenharia.
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho dos modelos implementados, propondo melhorias contínuas.
Requisitos:
  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Programação em Python ou R.
  • Bibliotecas e frameworks de análise e modelagem de dados (ex.: Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Fundamentos de estatística, probabilidade e modelagem preditiva.
  • Manipulação de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e/ou não relacionais.
  • Ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência prática com Deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção.
  • Vivência com ambientes de computação em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de MLOps.
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos de ciência de dados aplicados ao negócio.
Perfil profissional:
  • Visão analítica e foco em resultados.
  • Curiosidade intelectual e disposição para explorar novas abordagens e tecnologias.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, colaborar com diferentes áreas e comunicar soluções técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade, organização e autonomia para conduzir projetos.
  • Facilidade para lidar com desafios complexos, propondo soluções criativas e práticas.
Se você se identificou com a oportunidade, inscreva-se! Valorizamos potenciais, trajetórias diversas e acreditamos no desenvolvimento contínuo.

  • Prestar suporte na elaboração, revisão e formatação de propostas técnicas e comerciais, em português e inglês, garantindo conformidade com os padrões da empresa.
  • Auxiliar na gestão de contratos (clientes e fornecedores), controle de faturas, ordens de compra, notas fiscais e documentos administrativos vinculados a projetos de engenharia.
  • Participar de reuniões de projeto, elaborando atas detalhadas, acompanhando pendências e contribuindo com o fluxo de informações entre áreas técnicas e administrativas.

  • Garantir a confidencialidade, organização e rastreabilidade de todos os documentos sob sua responsabilidade, com foco em compliance e boas práticas de gestão da informação.

At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Administrative Assistant to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle and direct phone calls, emails, and correspondence professionally and in fluent English, ensuring efficient communication with clients, suppliers, and national and international partners.
  • Welcome visitors, suppliers, and external teams, providing logistical and administrative support to internal staff and engineers.
  • Manage the control of office supplies, technical materials, and equipment, ensuring timely restocking and organized inventory.
  • Maintain organized common areas and coordinate the supply of office and cleaning materials to support operational routines.
  • Create, update, and maintain administrative and technical databases, physical and digital filing systems, reports, records, and project documentation.
  • Proficiently use Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as corporate systems such as Ariba, Concur, and SAP, in support of engineering project routines.
  • Support internal and institutional communication activities, including presentations, marketing materials, and corporate events, while adhering to branding and technical standards.
  • Organize business travel, technical visits to construction sites, and external events, as well as manage reimbursement and expense reporting processes.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and formatting of technical and commercial proposals in both Portuguese and English, ensuring compliance with company standards.
  • Support contract management (clients and suppliers), invoice control, purchase orders, and administrative documents related to engineering projects.
  • Participate in project meetings by drafting detailed minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating communication between technical and administrative teams.
  • Coordinate logistics and structure for internal events, training sessions, and meetings with internal and external stakeholder

    Additional Responsibilities:
  • Support the management of contracts with technical suppliers and service providers, ensuring compliance with deadlines, scopes, and contractual terms.
  • Assist in controlling and presenting administrative and operational indicators related to projects and departmental performance.
  • Collaborate in the implementation and continuous improvement of internal processes, administrative workflows, and quality policies.
  • Serve as a link between technical teams (engineering, projects, production) and support departments (finance, procurement, HR, legal), promoting integration and workflow efficiency.
  • Manage the onboarding process for new employees, especially interns and junior engineers, by organizing logistics, documentation, and access to corporate tools.
  • Ensure the confidentiality, organization, and traceability of all documents under your responsibility, with a focus on compliance and best practices in information management.

Only candidates who meet the qualifications outlined in the job description will be considered by IPS.

  • Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas no setor de engenharia, atuando no suporte direto a equipes
  • técnicas, projetos multidisciplinares e áreas corporativas.

  • Professional with over 10 years of experience in administrative routines within the engineering sector, providing direct support to technical teams,
  • multidisciplinary projects, and corporate departments.
  • Fluent in English, capable of handling communication with international stakeholders, understanding technical documentation, and supporting the preparation of reports and presentations in English.

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway Company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. Its newest acquisition, Linesight, specializes in cost, schedule, risk, program, and project management services in various market sectors, including data centers, life sciences, and high-tech industries. With the addition of Linesight, IPS has over 3,000 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.

title: Governo do Estado nomeia 842 educadores
description:
A iniciativa tem como foco a valorização do magistério para garantir uma educação pública de qualidade.

O Governo do Estado publicou, na edição extra do Diário Oficial do Estado (DOE) desta sexta-feira (28), a relação dos 842 educadores aptos a serem nomeados, após aprovação e convocação no concurso público regido pelo Edital Saeb n° 03/2022. Este total refere-se as portarias de convocação, atrelados às 4ª, 5ª e última convocação para entrega de documentação para fins de nomeação.

A publicação destaca que são 387 professores e 151 coordenadores pedagógicos, que correspondem à 4ª convocação e mais 222 professores e 82 coordenadores pedagógicos, da 5ª convocação. Após a nomeação, a ser realizada pelo governador Jerônimo Rodrigues, os educadores terão o prazo de até 30 dias – contados da data da publicação do ato de nomeação no órgão oficial – para tomar posse.

Os candidatos nomeados para as escolas pertencentes ao Núcleo Territorial de Educação Salvador e Região Metropolitana (NTE 26) deverão comparecer à sede da Secretaria da Educação do Estado da Bahia, situada na Av. Luiz Viana Filho, nº 550, 5ª Avenida, Centro Administrativo da Bahia – CAB, 1º andar, sala 117. Já os candidatos aprovados para o interior do Estado deverão se dirigir para as sedes dos NTEs. É necessário apresentar documentação pessoal com foto.

O último concurso recebeu mais de 103 mil inscritos, divididos nos 27 Núcleos Territoriais de Educação, situados em Salvador e em outros 26 municípios do Estado. Foram ofertadas 2.113 vagas, sendo 1.806 para professores, 289 para o cargo de coordenador pedagógico e 18 para coordenador pedagógico indígena. Dos 4.923 habilitados no concurso, todos já foram convocados. Com a nova nomeação, já foram chamados 4.297 profissionais da Educação.

People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, care about safety, and share a vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to impact the future of urban mobility.

TK Elevator aims to lead in industrial IoT solutions, providing data-enabled software solutions that make our customers and users successful and satisfied.   • Proficiency in tools like Sketch, Adobe XD, Figma, or similar.
  • Solid knowledge of user-centered design principles and best practices.
  • Experience in B2B digital solutions with a focus on UX/UI as a product.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across disciplines and global teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits include healthcare, dental care, bonuses, private pension, programs for pregnant women, social support, life insurance, telemedicine, telenutrition, telepsychology, restaurant, and transportation.

TK Elevator is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or age.

title: Senior SAS Developer (SDTM)
description:
Company Description

We are the company that cares – for our staff, for our clients, for our partners and for the quality of the work we do. A dynamic, global company founded in 1995, we bring together more than 2,500 driven, dedicated and passionate individuals. We work on the frontline of medical science, changing lives, and bringing new medicines to those who need them.

Job Description

We are currently looking for a knowledgeable and proactive SAS Developer to join our global Data Management team. Please note the official PSI CRO job title will be: Senior Database Developer.

If you are keen to provide the full range of clinical database development and programming services, ensure high quality, accuracy, and consistency of clinical data, and be involved in something new, outstanding and challenging, this job opportunity is perfect for you!

Responsibilities:

  • Communication point for data management and statistics on matters of database programming and deliverable database development
  • Clinical database (EDC) requirements/structure review and testing
  • Data validation plan review and programming of data validation procedures
  • Generation of clinical database listings and reports to support clinical trial data collection, tracking, review and validation
  • Programming of patient profiles
  • Participate and support the development of Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) (define.xml, annotated CRF, reviewer’s guide) and programming of data transformation from raw data sources into CDISC-compliant deliverables
  • Validation of clinical trial data according to SDTM specifications
  • Deliverable database transfer to clients; electronic data transfers
  • Liaison with vendors and clients regarding electronic data transfer specifications
  • Receipt and validation of electronic data transfers

Qualifications:

  • College or University degree (IT, programming, technical education)
  • Full working proficiency in English
  • Sufficient relevant technical experience
  • Experience in Clinical Data Management systems (like Medidata/Veeva) is desirable
  • Knowledge of and experience in the SAS programming language (Base SAS, SAS/Macros, SAS/ODS)
  • Knowledge of CDISC standards
  • Knowledge of and experience in SQL
  • Proficient user of standard MS Office applications and MS Access
  • Experience in a professional environment, preferably with clinical or medical data

Only CVs in English will be considered.

If you feel it is time to make your skills and knowledge visible within a growing company with true focus on its people, then this is the right choice for you.

Our team consists of the very best; we believe in doing what is right for our customers and our employees. We provide our employees with the training, support and an opportunity for unlimited professional growth. Join us and become an EXPERT!

Position Summary:

The Dispatcher is responsible for coordinating the daily scheduling and dispatching of field technicians to job sites. This role serves as the primary point of contact between customers and field staff, ensuring efficient communication and timely service while prioritizing jobs based on urgency and availability. The ideal candidate will possess strong multitasking abilities, excellent customer service skills, and proficiency in dispatching software to streamline operations and meet service level agreements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answers incoming phone calls from customers and assists call or routes call to appropriate person

  • Receive and prioritize incoming service requests from customers, carefully documenting details related to the issue and location.
  • Utilize dispatching software to efficiently schedule and assign field technicians to job sites based on their availability, skill set, proximity to the location, and service call priority.
  • Monitor technicians' schedules and job progress throughout the day, making necessary adjustments and reassignments to maximize productivity and ensure timely service.
  • Act as the main point of contact between customers and field staff, providing updates on technician arrival times, service status, and addressing any customer inquiries or concerns.

  • Continually maintains working knowledge of all company products, services, and promotions

  • Ability to effectively communicate with co-workers and customers in a pleasant, business-like, and customer-focused manner. Ability to communicate with a diverse customer population.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships, and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Director, Product Sales – Open Finance Brazil Overview

The Open Finance team is looking for a talented Director, Product Sales to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.

Your primary objective will be to cultivate strong relationships with our partners to accelerate profitable revenue growth. To achieve this, you will work closely with Mastercard’s internal customer account management and services teams to architect, price, negotiate, contract, build out, and implement innovative financial services offerings across various Open Banking use cases. A key success factor will be leveraging deep client relationships and capabilities across the broader Mastercard business, integrating Open Banking services into the overall account plans that address our clients’ most pressing strategies.

Role

  1. Develop and execute segment-level go-to-market strategy for Mastercard Open Finance services.
  2. Build strong internal relationships and communication channels within the local market sales, business development, and product teams.

  4. Analyze client needs, conduct research, develop solutions, and devise tactical plans to pursue business opportunities.
  5. Manage the entire sales cycle from opportunity identification through pursuit, proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution.
  6. Integrate Open Finance priorities and opportunities within the broader Mastercard strategic account planning framework.
  7. Build and manage a robust pipeline by identifying and selling to prospects.
  8. Successfully close new business through consultative and relationship-based selling.
  9. Achieve and exceed assigned quotas.
  10. Capture and share client feedback with Open Finance stakeholders to enhance product and technology management processes.
  11. Stay updated on industry and technology landscape to serve as a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and internal stakeholders.

All About You

  • Agility and desire to demonstrate depth and breadth of knowledge and skills daily.
  • High level of partner/client management experience, including in sales/business development roles.

  • Strong working knowledge of technology, including APIs, cloud infrastructure, microservices, and SLAs.
  • Self-driven, proactive, motivated, and results-oriented.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks carry inherent risks. Employees and representatives must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices.
  • Ensure confidentiality and integrity of accessed information.
  • Report any suspected security violations or breaches.
  • Complete all mandatory security trainings as per Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Finance Manager - Brazil
description:
Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What's the opportunity?

As the Finance & Operations Manager for Brazil, you will oversee all local financial operations and ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory frameworks. You will lead Treasury, Accounting, and Foreign Exchange (FX/e-FX) functions, playing a strategic and operational role in supporting the company’s growth while maintaining financial integrity and regulatory alignment.


What will you be doing?
  • Lead and manage all financial operations in Brazil, including Treasury, Accounting, and FX/e-FX activities.
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian financial regulations (e.g., Banco Central, CVM), acting as the primary liaison with regulators, auditors, and external partners.
  • Design and implement robust financial controls, reporting frameworks, and treasury strategies aligned with both local regulations and global standards.
  • Monitor and manage cash flow, liquidity, capital requirements, and investment strategies to support operational and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee statutory financial reporting, tax compliance, and timely submission of all regulatory financial filings.
  • Collaborate closely with global Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure consistency between local practices and group-wide strategies.
  • Provide financial insights, risk assessments, and recommendations to support business growth and decision-making.
  • Represent the company in regulatory audits, board-level discussions, and relevant industry forums.
What skills do you need?
  • 8+ years of senior financial leadership experience within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (e.g., banks, payment institutions, fintechs).
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian financial regulations (BACEN) with a track record of regulatory engagement.
  • Proven experience managing Treasury, Accounting, and FX operations in complex or high-growth environments.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to build and execute scalable financial frameworks.
  • Hands-on leadership style, capable of both operational deep dives and high-level financial strategy.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, both internally and externally.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • A master's degree, an MBA, or a CPA/CRC certification is a strong plus.
  • SAP knowledge is a plus.
  • Full professional fluency in English is required.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

- Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*

- Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.

- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.

- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.

- Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.

- Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.

- Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!

- dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out ourwebpage ,Linkedin ,Instagram , andYoutube for more about dLocal!

  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region

Your Experience

  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements

  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes

  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally

Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.

The Team

You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes.

Our products run on intelligence and industry-specific insights provided by the industry teams. We combine financial modeling, industry expertise, data management, and technical skills to curate critical metrics and drive insights from our data.

We are dedicated to crafting a best-in-class financial analysis and modeling product while constantly looking to enhance and expand our existing offering through a deep understanding of the markets we operate in, the sectors we cover, and our clients current and future needs.

What’s the role?

The Company Financials Market Data team is looking for a Senior Market Data Analyst who combines strong relationship management, market insight, and regulatory awareness to lead product development to incorporate regional nuances and relevance to the respective markets. This role focuses on understanding financial market structure, maintaining strong partnerships, and ensuring data quality and timeliness to support our suite of Company Financials products. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and other Company Financials teams, helping shape the direction of our data offerings in response to client demand and market developments.

We’ll trust you to:

  • Monitor and interpret financial regulations, exchange rule changes, and emerging trends to ensure Bloomberg’s Company Financials data offering remains compliant, competitive, and market-leading.

  • Maintain and grow relationships with exchanges and third-party data vendors across multiple geographies to secure access to critical data sources and insights.

  • Lead initiatives to improve and expand market data coverage, helping design and manage structured projects aligned with business and client needs.

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (Engineering, Product, Financial Product, Compliance) to translate market needs into actionable data strategies.

  • Act as a subject matter expert on specific markets or data types, guiding how financial filings and disclosures are sourced, processed, interpreted, and used across Bloomberg platforms.

  • Contribute to the development of automation and monitoring tools by offering business insight and data structure understanding; some familiarity with Python or scripting is welcome.

  • Create and maintain clear documentation, business rules, and operating procedures to support team scalability and transparency.

  • Represent the Company Financials team in external engagements such as working groups, regulatory consultations, and client feedback sessions.

You’ll need to have:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in financial markets, particularly within market data, exchanges, investor relations, or regulatory environments.

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Deep understanding of company filings, financial disclosures, and market data structures.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive results across teams.

  • Proven track record of external stakeholder management and relationship building.

  • A proactive mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with an ability to distill complex issues for a variety of audiences.

We’d love to see:

  • Familiarity with the Bloomberg Terminal, Company Financials products, and/or Bloomberg’s data management workflows.

  • Experience working with or within financial exchanges or regulators.

  • Knowledge of key global financial reporting regimes (e.g. IFRS, US GAAP).

  • Exposure to data science or coding tools (e.g., Python, SQL) to support data exploration and project work.

  • Multilingual skills or experience working in a global context.

We are hiring a Senior CX Quality Manager to our CX Global team in São Paulo !

  • Full ownership on projects and tasks assigned together with being able to work within a Team;
  • Able to document well processes and perform knowledge sharing sessions

Some Key Requirements of what we would be looking for:

  • Experience with modern cloud database technologies such as Snowflake ;

  • Experience with any programming language like Python or Java;
  • Knowledge on AWS Services like S3/Lambda/API Gateways/DMS/RDS;
  • Development experience in both Microsoft , and Linux/Cloud environments;
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

It would be extra awesome if you also have experience with:

  • Familiar with Data Warehousing concepts and data modelling techniques such as Inmon, Kimball, Data Vault;

  • Familiar with software versioning tools like GIT ;
  • Familiar with infrastructure scripting like Terraform ;
  • Familiar with data flow systems such as Apache NiFi ;
  • Familiar with Data Monitoring and Visualisation tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, Cloudwatch ;
  • Scripting – Powershell, Unix Scripting;
  • At least 2 years experience in Data Engineering;
  • Excellent verbal and writing English communication skills;
